message.content:
**Monogamous** means having **one partner at a time**—usually in a romantic or sexual relationship.[3][5][6]

In plain English, a monogamous person or relationship is one where two people agree to be exclusive with each other, without other romantic or sexual partners.[3][4][6]

If you want, I can also explain the difference between **monogamous**, **polyamorous**, and **polygamous**.
